card.name: Inside code identifiers and addresses
card.fires_on: Pieces inside programming text, such as the backtick after a package name, single characters within hex memory addresses, and digits ending a function name.

modes.label: Hex addresses
modes.description: Single digits or letters inside a memory address.

modes.label: Code name joins
modes.description: Join marks or digits inside code names like package paths or function names.

modes.label: Device or method names
modes.description: Digit or piece within device names and dunder method names.
